race.title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Mares (Ladies Pro/Am) Flat Race
race.verdict: This doesn't look the strongest of bumpers, so LADY AURORA makes obvious appeal having joined Willie Mullins after running out an easy winner on her completed start in points. Found It should be capable of building on her opening effort under Rules at Punchestown in early-May, while Shuil Solas bumped into a good prospect on her penultimate outing and merits respect back in calmer waters. LADY AURORA (FR) FOUND IT (IRE) SHUIL SOLAS (IRE)
